name: Weisen Liu
bio: He is an actor from mainland China. He was born in Beijing in 1984 and has graduated from Haidian Art School.

credits.title: I Remember
credits.overview: When an average and unexciting IT worker meets the new girl in the office, the beautiful Zhao Ximan, he finds a reason to change his life. But Ximan hides a secret, she suffers from Global Transient Amnesia, meaning she won't remember anything tomorrow. How can he win her over?

credits.title: Parallel Forest
credits.overview: A mother who lost her child happened to find the entrance to the parallel world after being chased by another self in the forest.

credits.title: Doctor Monkey: Lady Killer
credits.overview: The second instalment of the Doctor Monkey franchise, Doctor Monkey Lady Killer is a Chinese wuxia drama set in the Qing dynasty.
